svg.text: Dam promenade — review option, not implemented
West stairs require a further dry-route solution. Art alignment alone does not make this route usable.
89.37 m west route = 36.40 m approach/stairs + 52.97 m crest
About 12.00 m longer than the old route; starts ~201.45 m lower along the road.
Stair climb 20.62 m; steepest flight 36.09°. Existing width 2.8 m. Crest width 3.6 m.
Blue samples: reservoir water at 140 m lies above stair floor. 33 whole-width sampled sections are wet.
Dashed red: old 24.52 m connector intersects pavilion/road; no same-line apron solution.
Not a new approved route. Preserve native road, terrain, collision, bridge and rails.
